title: schema
description: Deployment of Angular CLI applications to GitHub pages (angular-cli-ghpages)

baseHref.description: Base url for the application being built. Same as `ng build --base-href=/XXX/`.

buildTarget.description: The build target as `project:target[:configuration]`, e.g. `my-app:build:staging` (default: `<project>:build:production`). It also determines the output directory, with --no-build too.

prerenderTarget.description: A separate prerender target as `project:target[:configuration]` (e.g. `my-app:prerender:production` of a setup with a prerender builder). Takes precedence over --build-target. The application builder prerenders within the build target and needs no prerender target.

noBuild.description: Build the project before the deployment (default). `--no-build` (`noBuild: true` in angular.json) deploys the existing build output.

remote.description: Provide the remote name. If no value is provided, `origin` is used. Has no function if --repo is set.

repo.description: Provide the repository URL. If no value is provided, a remote of the current working directory is used (defaults to `origin`; see --remote for details).

branch.description: The git branch to push your pages to.

name.description: The git user-name which is associated with this commit.

email.description: The git user-email which is associated with this commit.

noSilent.description: Deprecated! This parameter has no effect and is ignored.

noDotfiles.description: Publish files and folders starting with `.` (default). `--no-dotfiles` (`noDotfiles: true` in angular.json) leaves them out.

noNotfound.description: Create a 404.html copy of index.html for SPA routing on GitHub Pages (default; it replaces a 404.html of the build). `--no-notfound` (`noNotfound: true` in angular.json) leaves it out, as Cloudflare Pages needs for its native SPA routing.

noNojekyll.description: Create a .nojekyll file, so GitHub Pages serves files starting with `_` without Jekyll processing (default). `--no-nojekyll` (`noNojekyll: true` in angular.json) leaves it out.

cname.description: Write a CNAME file with this domain into the deployment (it replaces a CNAME file of the build).

add.description: Only add, and never remove existing files from the GitHub pages branch.

dir.description: The directory to publish, relative to the current working directory or absolute (default: the browser output of the build target).

dryRun.description: Run the checks of a deploy and show the options, without cloning, committing or pushing anything.
